answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and measuring correlated equivocation across the swarm: if k identities coordinate conflicting votes, aggregate slashing grows as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controller’s escrowed stake. Splitting power across aliases therefore cannot dilute risk; yarrow, pigment, and horizon remain irrelevant labels, not exploitable trust signals.
